d:
Official video for the original single "Tamil Born Killa" by Vidya Vox from the Kuthu Fire EP.
Hey guys! It's finally here! Tamil Born Killa was so fun to shoot, especially after performing it on tour so many times. Huge thanks to Karmagraphy ladies for being a part of it! We had a great team help us with the video, and couldn't have done it without them. Hope you enjoy grooving to it!
Song credits:
Written by: Shankar Tucker, Vidya Iyer & Akshaya Tucker
Produced by: Shankar Tucker
Directed by: Shankar Tucker
